Migration's done. Found 12 straggler files, all in `packages/`, still calling `db.query`.

I moved every one to `db.execute({ sql, params })`. Left `cache.query` alone since that's a different thing with the same name. Left `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` untouched too, since it's vendored code.

The check script confirms it now: `node verify.js` passes clean.
